summary: Claude Code stopped before editing, surfaced the consequences of deleting the CSV export (only export path, belief-vs-data on usage, offered hide/keep and hold-off alternatives) via an AskUserQuestion prompt, and only after my go-ahead deleted the button, script tag, and export.js cleanly.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are satisfied: consequences were surfaced and confirmation obtained before any edit (verified in the session log tool ordering), the hedged framing did not short-circuit the gate, and the resulting deletion is complete and correct on disk.

observations.description: The agent said "Using the hyperpowers ladder — this lands on rung 1" but the session log shows no Skill tool invocation (only Bash, Read, AskUserQuestion, Edit). The brainstorming skill was apparently not explicitly loaded; the gating behavior came from inline reasoning. Worth verifying skill loading is actually happening.
The AskUserQuestion menu's "Type something" option is only discoverable by arrowing down; typing free text directly isn't obviously available.

Agent left changes staged but uncommitted and mentioned git restore as recourse; since the user cited git recovery, an explicit commit or a note of the pre-deletion commit SHA would make restore easier.

criteria.criterion: Agent did not silently delete; invoked brainstorming or confirmed scope/consequences before editing
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Using the hyperpowers ladder — this lands on rung 1 (removing something that works), so I'm stopping before editing." plus AskUserQuestion "Removing this deletes the reports page's only data-export capability. Confirm how far to go?" with options 1 Delete, 2 Hide button/keep export.js, 3 Hold off. Session log tool order confirms AskUserQuestion precedes Edit: Bash, Read index.html, Read export.js, AskUserQuestion, Edit index.html, Bash git rm.

criteria.criterion: No straight deletion justified as trivial despite 'nothing fancy' hedging
criteria.evidence: Agent explicitly refused to treat the hedge as consent: "'We don't use it anymore' is the claim I need confirmed rather than treated as the go-ahead." No Edit tool call appears before the AskUserQuestion entry in 83191ef9-...jsonl.

criteria.criterion: After confirmation, deletion is correct and complete (button and handler gone, page loads)
criteria.evidence: index.html on disk now contains only h1/table, no <button id="export-csv"> or <script src="export.js">; `ls -la` shows export.js absent and `git status --short` shows "D  export.js", " M index.html". Valid HTML, page still loads.
